kai-neutral-ref.png.note: Kai in his un-powered baseline state: flat neutral daylight, plain background, ordinary dark brown eyes, blue-black hair. Exists so his element cannot mistake the submerged Undertow glow for his permanent face.

luna-neutral-ref.png.note: Luna in neutral daylight on a plain background, pale ivory skin. Exists so her element cannot mistake violet underwater light for her skin tone.

crew-key-visual.png.generated_with: four locked elements, one per character in frame
crew-key-visual.png.status_note: First crew visual with every character element-locked. Kai's eyes correctly dark brown on dry land; Bo heavyset and fully clothed; Luna pale ivory. Supersedes cast-key-visual.png.

provenance_types.element_id: Generated with a locked character element. REQUIRED for all new character art. Multi-character art uses element_ids (a list) — one lock per character in frame.
provenance_types.derived-from-approved-plates: Composited/derived from approved plates with no generation. Identity is exact.
provenance_types.approved-plate-as-reference: Generated with an approved plate as image reference. Legacy-acceptable; weaker than element_id.
provenance_types.rejected-record: Retained only to document a rejection. Never ship.

cast-key-visual.png.reason: Kai's skin rendered lighter than his approved plate. Superseded by crew-key-visual.png, generated with locked elements.

cast-key-visual-alt.png.reason: Bo rendered lanky; canon requires heavyset. Never shipped. Superseded by crew-key-visual.png.
